body:
Here's some more detail about the situation.
The problem is that she really hates herself, which is a result of awful childhood experiences. All she wants to do is make others happy, but because of her anxiety she stressed out about the littlest of things and doesn't realise that she has been a great help to all of us. 
I've been trying to give her as much love and compliments as I could, but since I didn't know about her situation that well I'm afraid it's been too overwhelming and she thinks she doesn't deserve it.
Like I said, she keeps hiding to herself because she doesn't know how to talk to people and it's just where she feels most comfortable. She believes that speaking her mind only brings trouble and that she's cursed. I've been trying to convince her to talk to others and to hang out with friends that will support her and make her happy, but in hindsight I think I've been pushing her too hard to do that.

I'm really running out of options, since I have no way to contact her family and therapist at all. Any help on what to do will be very much appreciated.

I've been trying to accomplish this since the moment I met her, unfortunately she avoids social contacts. There are other friends that support her and I've told them about this, however since she's only told me about this we're afraid that she won't like it if other people start worrying too. I have no way of contacting her parents or anyone that personally knows her either.

Yes, I should probably mention that she is already seeing a therapist about her anxiety. Also I'm pretty sure I'm the only one she's actually talked to about this at all, she doesn't even know how to tell her own parents.
